| Tier | Discount | Hour | Day (8 hr) | Week (40 hr) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base | — | $120.00 | $800.00 | $3,000.00 |
| Discounted | 25% | $90.00 | $600.00 | $2,250.00 |
| Subsidised | 50% | $60.00 | $400.00 | $1,500.00 |
| **How it's charged** |  | Hours are logged to the quarter hour.  | Eight or more hours on a single day are charged at the day rate.  | The week rate applies only to a block of consecutive weeks agreed in advance.  |
